text:
maria: Kicking off a discrete thread for the Route Roadmap: need a prioritization framework that ties customer asks -> launch gates -> commercial milestone. Keep it pragmatic.

dan: Suggest a 4x2 matrix: impact (low/med/high) vs. implementation cost (low/med/high). Prioritize high-impact/low-cost items first for Q2.

aj: From runtime: must map each feature to specific perf experiments. Example mapping: 'regional affinity' -> canary workload 50k req/day, spike tests + cold-start histogram. Without those tests we can't sign off.

sophie: Proposal: policy DSL v0.1 with minimal operators to express: region, model_variant, latency_budget_ms, fallback_strategy, cost_budget. Keep syntax terse so UI can render diff when changing policies. Example: ```when region == "apac" and latency < 200 -> route: apac-quant; else -> route: global-fallback```

kevin: Risk list prioritized: 1) capacity fragmentation -> lost throughput 2) cross-region KV divergence -> incorrect responses 3) billing mismatch for routed fallbacks -> customer surprise. Mitigations: scheduled rebalancer, async KV reconciliation, transparent cost-estimate in console.

liam: Compliance: capture per-tenant crypto envelope id, per-deployment KMS status (ok/partial/blocked), and exportable audit CSV. Add a boolean gate `kms_integrated` for pilot acceptance.

cs_jen: Customer asks summary from pilots: predictable p95 <250ms for interactive use, clear rollback window (15m), and visible traffic-shift audit. Also pricing transparency when falling back to cheaper models.

product_ops_bot: milestone: routing-alpha -> created by maria, due: 2026-04-30, owners: product+eng.

maria: Launch gates (draft):
- Gate A (internal alpha): unit perf harness pass, basic policy DSL stable, canary w/ 100 synthetic users
- Gate B (customer pilot): p95 SLAs met under 2x expected load, KMS integration for pilot customers, rollback + telemetry verified
- Gate C (public beta): cost estimates published, A/B routing experiments supported, docs + SDK updates
- Gate D (GA): Dedicated mapping + contractual SLAs, compliance signoffs done

dan: For prioritization, include a sales urgency flag (0/1/2) so we can surface customer-funded work. If Sales marks 2, it moves up but must still satisfy gating tests.

aj: Metrics to instrument immediately: `p50_latency_ms`, `p95_latency_ms`, `p99_latency_ms`, `tokens_per_gpu/sec`, `batch_fill_rate`, `cache_prefix_hit_rate`, `session_stickiness`, `failover_success_rate`. Add tagging: route_policy_id, tenant_id, region.

sophie: Add quality gate: Redwood Optimize evals run nightly on canary routes. Gate fails if core prompt set accuracy drops >5% or hallucination increases beyond threshold. That blocks moving from Gate B -> C.

kevin: Cost modeling: we should show per-tenant delta for Phase 1->3 across three axes: infra cost, operational overhead, and expected revenue uplift. Quick back-of-envelope: Phase 1 = +5% infra, Phase 2 = +25%, Phase 3 = +150% (worst-case).

liam: Data residency nuance: some customers accept logical isolation (Phase 2) if KMS and egress controls are in place; others require physical isolation (Phase 3). We need to capture customer classification in the pilot intake form.

cs_jen: Pilot acceptance checklist (template): customer_id, tenant_classification, required_ksm (sic) level, target_p95_ms, allowed_fallbacks, rollback_window_minutes, contact_on_call. I'll circulate a filled example.

maria: Decision items for sync on Thu: confirm DSL fields, finalize Gate B perf thresholds, agree on sales urgency taxonomy, and owners for cost modeling.

product_ops_bot: reminder: meeting Thu 10:00 -> calendar invite sent to channel.

dan: One more ask: we need a migration story for tenants moving from soft-affinity -> physical isolation. Who owns rebalancer and data copy? Flagging for eng-runtime.

aj: Runtime will own rebalancer + canary re-route logic. Need product to specify acceptable disruption window (default 5m).

sophie: UX: console should preview expected latency and cost delta when editing a policy. That helps sales/demo. Small mockup can be done in two sprints.

kevin: I'll draft gating checklist JSON and attach cost calculator.

maria: Great. If no objections by Wed EOD, we'll lock the phases and start work. Thanks everyone.
